doc_title_en: Notice of Revised Consolidated Earnings Forecast for FY3/27 (Upward Revision) and Revised Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 2027年３月期の連結業績予想の修正（上方修正）および配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 中間期連結業績予想の修正を踏まえ、配当性向40～50%を目途とした安定的かつ継続的な配当の実現を基本方針

summary_en: ¥96.00/share annual dividend (mid-term ¥48.00, year-end ¥48.00) vs. prior ¥93.00 (mid-term ¥45.00, year-end ¥48.00). FY3/27 guidance. Payout ratio target 40–50%. Mid-term earnings raised 18.3% on semiconductor demand and India EV component sales growth. One-time merger accounting gains excluded from dividend cash basis.
summary_jp: ¥96.00/株の年間配当（中間¥48.00、期末¥48.00）対前回¥93.00。配当性向40～50%目途。中間期利益上方修正18.3%。経営統合による特別利益は配当原資に含めない方針。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - ¥96.00/share (was ¥93.00) - FY3/27 - Payout ratio 40–50% target
